name: ChatGPT Scheduled Task Recovery Controller
repair_order: native ChatGPT automation audit and repair
private Drive recovery registry refresh when available
public GitHub recovery incident/status/heartbeat when available
repair_scope: all current and future recurring ChatGPT scheduled tasks
secondary failsafe recovery of primary watchdog
unexpected disabled or paused recurring tasks
permission deadlocks and false permission prompts
durable recovery queues for broken or stalled chats
enabled tasks whose last_run_time stops advancing across expected cadences
automatic clean replacement of poisoned recurring tasks while tombstoning legacy instances
critical_invariants: native scheduler repair has zero external connector dependency
is_enabled=true is never treated as sufficient proof of execution health
real task work is never blocked on Plugin Management
workers never ask the user for connector permission during unattended scheduled runs
known gated actions are skipped before invocation rather than attempted and recovered afterward
Gmail and Outlook are never invoked by unattended workers unless app-specific Allow all actions is actually confirmed
GitHub and Google Drive task work begins immediately when their connectors are usable
unexpected GitHub permission prompts never stop watchdog repair
poisoned Follow-up/needs-attention task instances are replaced cleanly and tombstoned
temporary failures never self-disable a recurring task
primary watchdog and secondary failsafe remain independent
preserve full original task scope when repairing prompts
persist last-known-good recovery state outside the chat
change strategy after repeated unchanged failure instead of looping

known_platform_state.gmail_app_permission: Use my default — suppress unattended calls
known_platform_state.outlook_email_app_permission: Use my default — suppress unattended calls
known_platform_state.plugin_permission_write_endpoint: HTTP 404 before invocation as last observed

external_recovery_limit: GitHub can detect stale ChatGPT heartbeat and preserve recovery state, but cannot directly inject messages into arbitrary ChatGPT conversations without a supported ChatGPT automation/webhook API.
secrets_policy: Never store credentials, OAuth tokens, cookies, passwords, or private session secrets.

latest_incident.root_cause: a gated connector call can suspend a scheduled run before prompt-level recovery logic executes
latest_incident.mitigation: remove gated calls from unattended path entirely and detect stale last_run_time
